author: gyalchester
body:
Hello!

This is for any senior that can answer or help me.

I have two suggestions/questions,

1. Is there an Avicus discord server and if not, would it be possible for Avicus to create one? This could bring more people to talk with others since some people are not to familiar with TeamSpeak or just don't use it. Another reason for why this could work is that it is completely free.

2. This is more of a request: On the sub topics on the left of the screen, would it be possible to to add a sub topic called "Suggestions?" This could help a lot of people with questions/suggestions so that they do not have to go and bother admins or others about things and would be much easier.

Thank you.

title: Suggestions and Discord

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello,

There is no official Avicus discord server. There is an unofficial one though but for now we're going to stick with Teamspeak.

https://avicus.net/forums/categories/32 Is where you can post your suggestions.
